changelog:
- Pitwall Cloud Engine — Migrated data layer to a dedicated cloud service for instant, crash-free loading.

- Battery & Smoothness — Eliminated background processing to make the app faster and extend battery life.

- UI Refinements — Made general interface fixes and visual polish in the Standings and Pitwall sections.

- Smooth Season Switching — Enjoy seamless slide transitions and instant year switching in the Schedule section.

- Polished Year Selector — Redesigned year picker with a sleek, compact look aligned perfectly with race cards.

- Pitwall News Feed — Enhanced the news carousel with smooth snap scrolling, tactile haptic feedback, fresh 5-minute updates, and loading shimmers.
